anc_visits.title_twi: Asibiti Kɔ a Edi Kan (ANC Booking)
anc_visits.description_english: Initial health assessment, blood pressure, urine test, hemoglobin check, and blood grouping.
anc_visits.description_twi: Wo nipadua nhwehwɛmu a edi kan, mogya mmoroso, nsɔebua, ne anemia nhwehwɛmu.

anc_visits.title_twi: Asibiti Kɔ a Tɔ so Mmienu (Ultrasound Scan)
anc_visits.description_english: Fetal growth scan, maternal wellness check, SP malaria prevention dose 1.
anc_visits.description_twi: Abofra nyinsɛn scanning, ne SP asram aduru a edi kan.

anc_visits.title_twi: Asibiti Kɔ a Tɔ so Mmiɛnsa
anc_visits.description_english: Check fetal lie and heartbeat, iron supplement adjustment, SP malaria dose 2.
anc_visits.description_twi: Abofra awoɛ gyinabea nhwehwɛmu ne iron supplement nhyehyɛeɛ.

anc_visits.title_twi: Asibiti Kɔ a Tɔ so Nan (Awoɛ Ahoboa)
anc_visits.description_english: Final birth preparedness, emergency referral plan, hospital bag setup.
anc_visits.description_twi: Awoɛ ho ahoboa, ne hospital bag ahoboa.

immunizations.description_english: Protects against Tuberculosis and Infant Polio.
immunizations.description_twi: Ɛbɔ abofra no ho ban firi Tuberculosis ne Polio yareɛ ho.

immunizations.description_english: Protects against Diphtheria, Tetanus, Pertussis, Hepatitis B, Hib, Rotavirus diarrhea, Pneumococcus.
immunizations.description_twi: Ɛbɔ abofra no ho ban firi ayaase yareɛ, kɔfe, ne ayamtu yareɛ ho.

immunizations.description_english: Second dose booster for infant immunity.
immunizations.description_twi: Dose a tɔ so mmienu de hyɛ abofra no nipadua den.

immunizations.description_english: Crucial 9-month immunization against measles and yellow fever.
immunizations.description_twi: Nsuro a ɛho hia pa ara de bɔ abofra no ho ban firi Ntoburo ne Yellow Fever ho.
